2608.30213.title: Towards a Joint Khmer Text Recognition and Word Segmentation
2608.30213.paper_summary: Text recognition, or extracting electronic text from document images, has been indispensable for knowledge retrieval tasks, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For Khmer, extracted text is subject to an extra word segmentation step, as Khmer does not use any visible word delimiters to denote word boundaries. Thus, a recognition-then-segmentation pipeline for Khmer requires two separate sequential models; this is not only error-prone but also adds significant latency for large-scale document processing. This paper proposes a novel joint Khmer text recognition and word segmentation framework in a unified model. The proposed model, using a connectionist-temporal-classification (CTC) decoder for fast, parallel decoding, can be instructed to recognize Khmer text with ($b=1$) and without ($b=0$) word segmentation. Experimental results on different benchmark datasets of different document modalities (document, scene, and handwritten images) show that the proposed model can not only recognize characters in document images but also locate word boundaries, removing the need for an extra word segmentation step in a conventional sequential pipeline.
2608.30213.paper_summary_zh: 文本識別，即從文檔影像中提取電子文本，對於知識檢索任務（例如檢索增強生成（RAG））是不可或缺的。對於高棉語，提取的文本需要經過額外的詞語分割步驟，因為高棉語不使用任何可見的詞語分隔符來標示詞語邊界。因此，對於高棉語的識別-然後-分割流程需要兩個獨立的順序模型；這不僅容易出錯，還會為大規模文檔處理增加顯著的延遲。本文提出了一種新穎的高棉語文本識別和詞語分割框架，並將其整合為一個統一模型。所提議的模型使用連接主義時間分類（CTC）解碼器進行快速、並行的解碼，可以被指示識別高棉語文本，無論是有詞語分割（$b=1$）還是沒有詞語分割（$b=0$）。在不同文檔類型（文檔、場景和手寫影像）的不同基準數據集上的實驗結果顯示，所提議的模型不僅可以識別文檔影像中的字符，還可以定位詞語邊界，從而消除了傳統順序流程中額外詞語分割步驟的需求。
